question: In which cakra located at the liṅga should the next placement be made?
premises: It is situated at the liṅga.
inference: One should place the mantra in the six-petaled svādhiṣṭhāna cakra situated at the liṅga.
plain_english: One should place it in the six-petaled cakra named svādhiṣṭhāna, situated at the liṅga.
